name: Poisoned_Dagger
display_help: You throw an envenomed blade at your target causing a moderate amount of lethal damage and causing them to suffer a fair amount of toxic damage over time. Foes struck by the Poisoned Dagger will also have their damage decreased. Damage: Moderate, Recharge: Fast
display_short_help: Ranged, Moderate DMG(Lethal), Foe Light DoT(Toxic), -DMG
